q.en: The Fibonacci sequence is F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1, F(n) = F(n−1) + F(n−2). Naive recursion takes exponential time, but dynamic programming (or iteration) takes linear time. What is the fundamental reason for this huge difference?
q.zh: 斐波那契數列的定義為F(0)=0,F(1)=1, F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2)。使用樸素遞迴方法計算F(n)的時間複雜度是指數級的。而使用動態規劃(或迭代)方法的時間複雜度是線性的。造成這種巨大差異的根本原因是?( )

options.en: the recursive call stack costs too much
options.zh: 遞迴函式呼叫棧開銷過大

options.en: the operating system limits recursion depth
options.zh: 作業系統對遞迴深度有限制

options.en: naive recursion has many overlapping subproblems that are recomputed instead of reused
options.zh: 樸素遞迴中存在大量的重疊子問題未被重複利用
動態規劃使用了更少的資料儲存空間
